policyImplication: Uncorroborated (no onset lock) geometric offsets are trusted only when they are near-exact whole-beat/bar multiples; otherwise the whole-beat component is a grid-labeling choice and only the sub-beat residual is applied.

outcome.policy: bakeWindowAlignment reduces uncorroborated offsets via uncorroboratedGeometricOffsetMs (10 ms multiple tolerance). Synthetic equivalents in packages/catalog/test/windows.test.ts.
outcome.pilot-634: REPAIRED: the join now bakes the sub-beat residual and the real-library baseline probe passes (was review +49.7 ms).
outcome.pilot-298: PARTIALLY REPAIRED, root cause deeper: the baked offset correctly reduced -298 -> +47, but the probe still measures +108.3 ms IDENTICAL to before - the incoming's 0.6-confidence REFERENCE grid is mislabeled ~108 ms against its own audio, so no window choice can align it. outcome.pilot-298-refinement: Checked the stored evidence (2026-10-12): the DSP's whole-track gridPhaseMaxErrorMs is 25 ms (NOT suspect) while the join-local probe measures 108 ms - a global-vs-local trust gap. The stored bars series carries per-BEAT amplitudes only (no sub-beat phase), so join-local grid verification requires NEW per-interval evidence emission - Q05's local-confidence slice, not a quick gate.
